description: Parameters for deriving the computing price per 1 kW server-hour from an Azure Retail Prices snapshot (ticket T-28). Method: docs/research/computing-price.md §2 (mapping), §3 A1/A2 (Swiss on-demand/spot per server-hour) and C1 (spot x home-host ratio). Read by scripts/fetch_prices.py. Server power comes from config/reference-house.json (ServerElectricKw), not from here.

AzureRegion.source: docs/research/computing-price.md §3 A2: Azure Switzerland North spot prices

AzureCurrency.source: API default currency; converted with UsdToChf below as in WP1 (data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv)

value.source: data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv row cp-cpu-azure-d32as-v5-chn-od (32 vCPU, 128 GiB, AMD), accessed 2026-11-20
data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv row cp-cpu-azure-d32s-v5-chn-od (32 vCPU, 128 GiB, Intel), accessed 2026-11-20

Instances.unit: Azure VM sizes with vCPU count and RAM in GB
Instances.source: docs/research/computing-price.md §2-§3 A2: the 32-vCPU Azure sizes used for the 1 kW mapping (GiB used as GB, as in that note)

WattsPerVcpuAtFullLoad.source: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology, Appendix I, Azure max W per vCPU, https://github.com/cloud-carbon-footprint/cloud-carbon-footprint/blob/e48c659f6dafc8b783e570053024f28b88aafc79/microsite/docs/Methodology.md (accessed 2026-11-21), as used in docs/research/computing-price.md §2

WattsPerGbMemory.source: same Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology, memory coefficient, as used in docs/research/computing-price.md §2

UsdToChf.source: docs/research/ai-services.md 'Exchange rate': ECB reference rate 2026-11-17 cross rate 0.9233 / 1.0989 (confidence medium)

HomeHostRatioPairs.unit: row ids in data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv; ratio = community value / datacentre value, the lowest ratio is used
HomeHostRatioPairs.source: docs/research/computing-price.md §3 C1/C2: community/datacentre price ratio from RunPod (lowest ratio, RTX 4090, 0.38); only pairs with both prices as CSV rows are listed (GPU evidence applied to CPU: assumption)

AdoptedComputePriceChfPerServerHour.source: docs/research/computing-price.md: team decision 2026-11-21 (anchor A3, Hetzner dedicated server; no public price API, so not updated automatically). Used here only for comparison.
